vocabulary.meaning_en: a feeling of worry and pressure caused by too much work or problems
vocabulary.example: Tight deadlines cause a lot of stress.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling that you must do a lot quickly
vocabulary.note_ar: work pressure = ضغط العمل؛ under pressure = تحت الضغط
vocabulary.example: He works well under pressure.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a serious disagreement between people or groups
vocabulary.example: There is a long conflict between the two departments.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an angry talk where people disagree loudly
vocabulary.note_ar: من الفعل argue؛ لاحظ حذف e: argue → argument
vocabulary.example: They had an argument about who made the mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when people understand something in the wrong way
vocabulary.example: The problem started with a small misunderstanding.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when something happens later than planned
vocabulary.example: The client was unhappy about the delay.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something done wrong by accident
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول make a mistake وليس do a mistake
vocabulary.example: I made a mistake in the email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a technical problem; also the responsibility for something bad
vocabulary.note_ar: Whose fault is it? = من المسؤول / على من اللوم؟
vocabulary.example: There is a fault in the computer system.

vocabulary.meaning_en: lack of success
vocabulary.example: In good companies, failure is a chance to learn.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the state of having no job
vocabulary.example: Unemployment is high in some areas.

vocabulary.meaning_en: officially leaving your job
vocabulary.note_ar: resign = يستقيل؛ حرف g صامت في resign
vocabulary.example: Ali handed in his resignation on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a way to fix a problem
vocabulary.example: We need a quick solution to this problem.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: لا نقول an advice ولا advices، بل a piece of advice. الفعل advise بحرف s
vocabulary.example: My manager gave me some good advice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: help and encouragement
vocabulary.example: The team needs more support during busy weeks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when people come together to talk
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول call a meeting أو hold a meeting وليس make a meeting
vocabulary.example: The boss called a meeting this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: comments about how well someone did something
vocabulary.example: The supervisor gave me useful feedback.

vocabulary.meaning_en: teaching people the skills for a job
vocabulary.example: New staff get two weeks of training.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a change that makes something better
vocabulary.example: There has been a big improvement in sales.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working together to reach a goal
vocabulary.example: Without cooperation, the project will fail.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person in charge of you at work
vocabulary.example: My boss is very fair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق /ˈkɒliːɡ/ والـ ue في آخرها صامتة
vocabulary.example: I had lunch with my colleagues.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who watches and directs other workers
vocabulary.example: Ask your supervisor before you leave early.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who works for a company
vocabulary.example: The company has 50 employees.

vocabulary.meaning_en: hard and tiring to do
vocabulary.example: It was a difficult week for everyone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: hard but interesting, helping you grow
vocabulary.example: The new project is challenging, but I'm learning a lot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: always seeing the bad side of things
vocabulary.example: One negative person can affect the whole team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: hopeful and seeing the good side of things
vocabulary.example: Try to stay positive during hard times.

vocabulary.meaning_en: giving help and encouragement
vocabulary.example: My colleagues were very supportive when I was ill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling of being upset because you can't do or change something
vocabulary.example: The long delays caused frustration among the staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to succeed in dealing with a problem
vocabulary.example: The team overcame the crisis together.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last date to finish something
vocabulary.example: We have a tight deadline this week.

fine_lines.title: argument vs conflict
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان خلاف لكن على مستوى مختلف. argument مشادّة كلامية بصوت عالٍ تسمعها أمامك في الممر أو المكتب وقد تنتهي بعد دقائق. conflict صراع عميق وتصادم في المصالح أو الأهداف، وقد يستمر شهوراً في صمت دون أن يرفع أحد صوته.

examples.sentence: I heard an argument in the hallway.
The conflict between the two managers lasted for months.

fine_lines.title: mistake vs fault
fine_lines.explanation_ar: mistake خطأ عفوي غير مقصود سببه العجلة أو السهو أو التعب، مثل حرف خطأ في إيميل. fault له معنيان: عطل تقني في جهاز أو نظام، أو المسؤولية واللوم عن مشكلة. عندما يسأل الناس Whose fault is it? فهم لا يسألون ماذا حدث، بل من المسؤول.

examples.sentence: Sorry, I made a mistake in your name.
The machine stopped because of an electrical fault.
It's not my fault the report was late.

fine_lines.title: difficult vs challenging
fine_lines.explanation_ar: difficult صعب ومُتعب فقط. challenging صعب أيضاً لكنه ممتع ومفيد، يدفعك لتتجاوز حدودك وتتطوّر وتثبت نفسك. لذلك challenging كلمة أكثر إيجابية.

examples.sentence: It was difficult to sleep with all that noise.
My new role is challenging, and I love it.

fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice بحرف c اسم غير معدود = نصيحة، ولا نقول an advice. advise بحرف s فعل = ينصح، ويُنطق بصوت z.

examples.sentence: Let me give you a piece of advice.
I advise you to talk to HR.

expressions.meaning_ar: يتّفق تماماً مع شخص / يرى الأمر بنفس الطريقة
expressions.example: After a long meeting, the team finally saw eye to eye on the plan.
The manager called a meeting to discuss the delay.
A small argument turned into a big conflict.
Here's a piece of advice: always check your work.
In the end, the project was a success.

grammar.title: was / were going to: plans that didn't happen
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم was/were going to + الفعل في صورته الأساسية للتعبير عن نيّة أو خطة كانت في أذهاننا في الماضي، لكن شيئاً حدث فمنعها. غالباً تأتي بعدها but وسبب التغيير.
examples: I was going to send the report, but I found a mistake.
They were going to launch the project on Monday, but there was a delay.
We were going to cancel it, but we saw eye to eye.

grammar.title: Uncountable nouns: advice, feedback
grammar.explanation_ar: advice و feedback اسمان غير معدودين، فلا نضع قبلهما a ولا نجمعهما. نقول some advice أو a piece of advice.
examples: She gave me some useful advice.
Can I give you a piece of advice?

questions.question: Two colleagues are shouting at each other in the hallway. This is an:
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She gave me a good advice.
She gave me a piece of advice.
questions.explanation_ar: advice غير معدود فنقول a piece of advice.

questions.question: I ___ call you, but my phone died.
questions.explanation_ar: خطة في الماضي لم تحدث = was going to.

questions.question: "We finally see eye to eye" means we:
questions.explanation_ar: see eye to eye = يتّفق تماماً.

questions.question: The computer stopped because of a technical ___.
The manager ___ a meeting to solve the problem.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول call a meeting وليس make a meeting.

questions.question: A task that is hard but helps you grow is:
A deep, long disagreement between two departments is a:
questions.explanation_ar: conflict صراع عميق قد يستمر طويلاً.

questions.question: Ali was unhappy at work, so he wrote a letter to his boss and handed in his ___.
"They ___ to open the new branch, but they didn't have enough money."
questions.explanation_ar: were going to لخطة في الماضي لم تتحقق.
